findings.reason: The 24 h serum cell is <LLOQ, but this item gives no numeric LLOQ. The censored value must remain distinct from zero and missing.

findings.reason: The values are mean ± SD summaries from different groups at each time. This item provides no verified individual trajectories or animal variability across time.
findings.needed_material: Retain group-level and terminal-sampling design in the animal PK input assessment; obtain verified individual records only if individual variability is required.
